test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter-cluster series?

FZ, GA, JZ, OA, ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d357cf4fded0c8a4f1a722c864bfbc07eae23a8570898c00273ebff180bff751.png] 

**Given:**

FZ, GA, JZ, OA,?

**Logic: **Addition of consecutive odd numbers in the first letter and addition of (1) and subtraction of (1) alternatively in the second letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2906f3cee0ee403f1bb9f96d80d511ce8fbcafc8a7f290b9868b73135f8ee08.png] 

Here,** 'VZ' **is the next term.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
